metadata.description: Pre-computed, offline-verified response cache for high-frequency corporate policy and event queries

entries.canonical_query: I need to cancel a corporate event booked for next week because of a force majeure closure.
semantic_patterns: cancel a corporate event due to force majeure
entries.grounded_response: Under enterprise event policy [DOC_04_§3], cancellations resulting from documented force majeure events (such as natural disasters or government-mandated facility closures) are completely exempt from standard cancellation windows. All deposits and fees are eligible for a 100% full refund regardless of notice period.

claims.text: Cancellations resulting from documented force majeure events are exempt from standard cancellation windows.
Force majeure event cancellations receive a full 100% refund of all deposits.

sub_queries: corporate event cancellation force majeure refund policy

entries.canonical_query: I need to organize a customer workshop in Pune for 30 people, and I need the venue and catering options.
entries.grounded_response: For a 30-person workshop in Pune, Venue B (Grand Hall Conference Suite) accommodates 30 seated theatre-style with breakout rooms [DOC_02_§2], while Venue A (Riverside Business Center) seats up to 40 with projector and standard AV [DOC_02_§1]. For catering, three standard packages are available: Package 1 (breakfast), Package 2 (working lunch), and Package 3 (full-day catering) [DOC_05_§1].

claims.text: Venue B accommodates 30 seated theatre-style with breakout rooms.
Venue A accommodates 40 seated with projector and standard AV.
Three standard catering packages (breakfast, working lunch, full-day) are available.

sub_queries: customer workshop venue capacity Pune 30 people

entries.canonical_query: What are the standard cancellation rules for corporate events?
entries.grounded_response: Corporate event cancellations adhere to standard tiered notice windows [DOC_04_§1]: cancellations made more than 30 days prior receive a full refund; cancellations between 15 and 30 days receive a 50% refund; cancellations made under 15 days prior are non-refundable. Approved refunds are processed within 10 business days [DOC_04_§2].

claims.text: Cancellations over 30 days prior to the event receive a full refund.
Cancellations between 15 and 30 days prior receive a 50% refund.
Cancellations under 15 days prior are non-refundable.
Refunds are processed within 10 business days of cancellation confirmation.

sub_queries: standard cancellation windows corporate events refund percentage

entries.canonical_query: the cancellation was due to a government mandated closure
entries.grounded_response: Following up on cancellation terms for force majeure [DOC_04_§3]: cancellations resulting from documented force majeure events (such as government-mandated closures or natural disasters) are specifically exempt from standard cancellation windows and eligible for a 100% full refund regardless of notice period.

claims.text: Documented force majeure events like government closures exempt bookings from standard windows.
Force majeure cancellations receive a full 100% refund regardless of notice period.

sub_queries: force majeure government mandated closure cancellation exemption full refund

entries.canonical_query: Can I get reimbursement for using my personal vehicle?
entries.grounded_response: Under the Domestic Travel Reimbursement Policy [DOC_06_§1], ground transportation is an eligible business travel expense, and expenses over ₹500 require itemized receipts submitted through the Expense Portal within 15 days [DOC_06_§2]. However, specific per-kilometer mileage reimbursement rates for personal vehicle usage are not defined in the current travel policy.

claims.text: Ground transportation is an eligible reimbursable expense for domestic business travel.
Expenses over ₹500 require itemized receipts submitted within 15 days of trip completion.
Specific per-kilometer personal car mileage rates are not defined in the current policy.

sub_queries: ground transportation domestic travel reimbursement policy receipt requirements

entries.canonical_query: I need the approval requirements for standard domestic travel expenses
entries.grounded_response: Under the standard domestic travel workflow [DOC_09_§1], expense reports under ₹25,000 require only direct manager approval. Approved reimbursements are disbursed within 7 business days of final approval [DOC_06_§3].

claims.text: Expense reports under ₹25,000 require only direct manager approval.
Approved reimbursements are disbursed within 7 business days of final approval.

sub_queries: standard domestic travel expense approval threshold manager sign off

entries.canonical_query: the total expense claim exceeds 25000 rupees
entries.grounded_response: Updating approval requirements when exceeding the threshold [DOC_09_§2]: expense reports exceeding ₹25,000 require Senior Director approval in addition to the standard direct manager sign-off.

claims.text: Expense reports exceeding ₹25,000 require Senior Director approval in addition to manager sign-off.

sub_queries: elevated approval threshold exceeding 25000 rupees senior director

entries.canonical_query: What are the vendor contract cancellation terms?
entries.grounded_response: Standard vendor payment terms are net-30 from invoice date [DOC_10_§1]. Directly contracted event vendors (catering, AV, staging) may enforce a 14-day cancellation notice period for full refund eligibility [DOC_10_§2], which differs from the internal event policy's 30-day window.

claims.text: Standard vendor payment terms are net-30 from invoice date.
Directly contracted event vendors may enforce a 14-day cancellation notice period.

sub_queries: procurement vendor payment terms cancellation notice clause 14 days

entries.canonical_query: I need to submit an event booking request for our team offsite
entries.grounded_response: Event booking requests for team offsites must be submitted through the Events Portal at least 10 business days before the event date, including attendee count, preferred city, and duration [DOC_01_§1]. Events for up to 50 attendees require direct manager approval [DOC_01_§2], and venue confirmation takes 3 to 5 business days [DOC_01_§3].

claims.text: Booking requests must be submitted at least 10 business days before the event date.
Events up to 50 attendees require direct manager approval.
Venue confirmation typically takes 3 to 5 business days after submission.

sub_queries: event booking request submission advance notice lead time approval

entries.canonical_query: I need to find a venue in Bangalore for 50 people and also need the standard catering packages
entries.grounded_response: In Bangalore, Venue D at Whitefield Business Hub accommodates 50 seated attendees with standard AV included [DOC_03_§1]. For smaller groups, Venue E on MG Road seats 25 [DOC_03_§2]. Standard catering offerings include Package 1 (breakfast), Package 2 (working lunch), and Package 3 (full-day catering) [DOC_05_§1].

claims.text: Venue D at Whitefield Business Hub in Bangalore seats 50 with standard AV included.
Three standard catering packages (breakfast, lunch, full-day) are available.
